changes.title: Planted feet
items: Creatures' feet stay planted on the ground as they walk: no more sliding, walking in place, or gliding with still legs
Their stride matches how fast they go, and they stop stepping when they stop

changes.title: Walk room
items: Her bedroom is twice the size, with more of her mess: a clothes rail, a bookcase and open rune books, a bass, a beanbag and her records
Walk her round the bedroom with WASD or the arrows while the forest loads; she bumps into the furniture and goes behind it

changes.title: Decide
items: Press F2 (or add ?decide to the link) for a decisions panel down the right: try a setting live, then Confirm sends your choice
